conviction_note: FY2025/26 was already put out in the 3 Aug ad-hoc (EBITDA about EUR 192m, net debt EUR 92m), so the only new number on 24 Sep is the FY2026/27 outlook. Verbio's stated habit is to set that outlook on historical spreads below the latest year's, and it sits against a single-source consensus of EUR 266m EBITDA, so a guide below consensus is the base case. A likely return of the dividend partly offsets that. But the market saw this conservative-guide pattern three times in FY26, the stock sits at about 15x consensus EPS and far below every target, and the one comparable day (25 Sep 2025) closed +1.5%. So the findings sum of -0.5 is cut to -0.4, and the bar is unsourced to two agreeing estimate sources, which caps every size.
bar: FY2025/26 EBITDA bar is the company's own ad-hoc figure of about EUR 192m (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/verbio-se-preliminary-ebitda-for-fy-2025-2026-exceeds-forecast/31cf057f-fad8-477c-a599-87d107b49e0b_en), so the reported year should print on it (0%). The bar that matters is FY2026/27: consensus EBITDA EUR 265.81m, EPS EUR 2.02 and dividend EUR 0.07 from 4 analysts (https://www.finanzen.net/schaetzungen/verbio). That is ONE aggregator and visibly partly stale: its FY26e of EUR 173.87m sits below the pre-released EUR 192m. No second agreeing source could be reached (MarketScreener returns 403; mwb's research-hub is JavaScript). So the forward bar is effectively unsourced and every size is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct of -10 is my estimate of where the guide midpoint lands against that EUR 266m.

findings.finding: The only new number on 24 Sep is the FY2026/27 EBITDA outlook. Verbio's stated method is to guide on historical market spreads below the latest year's: last September it guided 'high double-digit million' for a year that ended at EUR 192m. Consensus for FY2026/27 is EUR 266m EBITDA, +55% on FY26's underlying of about EUR 172m (EUR 192m less a roughly EUR 20m GHG-quota inventory write-back). So an initial guide with a midpoint below consensus is the likely outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 25 Sep 2025: initial conservative FY26 guide, stock +1.46% (from a depressed base near EUR 11). 12 Feb 2026: guide only firmed to the top of the range after a run to multi-year highs, -7.25%. 25 Mar 2026 ad-hoc raise: +6.43%. 13 May 2026 Q3 with guide firmed: +15.43%. 4 Aug 2026, the session after the late-evening ad-hoc beat: +6.50%. Guide news moves this stock 6-15% either way, and the sign follows the setup going in. All closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/VBK.DE?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.original_quote: Der Vorstand geht davon aus, im Geschäftsjahr 2025/26 ein EBITDA im hohen zweistelligen Millionenbereich und damit deutlich über dem Vorjahr zu erzielen. Er legt dabei historische Markt-Spreads zugrunde, die unterhalb der im Geschäftsjahr 2024/25 erzielten Spreads liegen [The Management Board expects EBITDA in the high double-digit million range in FY 2025/26, significantly above the prior year. It bases this on historical market spreads below those achieved in FY 2024/25]
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus has not been re-anchored to the company's own guiding method: the EUR 265.81m FY27e (https://www.finanzen.net/schaetzungen/verbio) is a simple mean of four estimates, one of them evidently pre-August, and none is a company number. If the market expected a guide near EUR 266m, the stock would trade near the EUR 36-44 targets rather than EUR 30.72 at about 15x consensus EPS. That discount shows the price already doubts consensus, which is why this is sized small. What is not visible in the price is a pre-print move: run-up is -3.46% over 20 days and -1.60% over 5, no short building on the register, and no Directors' Dealings since 29 May.
findings.independence: Partial. NuWays (31 Aug 2026) quantifies the one-off: 'Excluding a c.€ 20m one-off benefit from GHG quota inventory write-down reversals, underlying EBITDA recovered to c.€ 172m' (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/research/original-research-verbio-se-von-nuways-ag-buy/bfbedb5c-d10e-493d-942e-ab0edc30b439_en). The company's own 27 May ad-hoc puts that reversal at 'less than EUR 20 million' (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/verbio-se-verbio-increases-ebitda-forecast-for-the-financial-year-2025-2026-again/58becdba-fb73-4bb5-b49c-8f58eebe11c7_en). The guiding-method sentence and the consensus figure are each single-sourced.

findings.finding: The annual report carries the dividend proposal for FY2025/26. Consensus is EUR 0.07, below Verbio's prior EUR 0.20. Net debt fell to about EUR 92m from EUR 164m and EBITDA beat guidance, and last year the CEO committed to return to at least the usual level, though he said 'in the medium term'. A reinstatement at or near EUR 0.20 would be a small positive against the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: One observation only: the 25 Sep 2025 release carried the dividend suspension alongside the new guide, and the stock closed +1.46%. The dividend line was not isolable from the guide that day.
findings.original_quote: Wir halten an unserem Ziel einer verlässlichen Dividende fest und sind optimistisch, mittelfristig mindestens zur gewohnten Höhe zurückzukehren. [We hold to our goal of a reliable dividend and are optimistic about returning to at least the usual level in the medium term.]
findings.why_not_priced: The EUR 0.07 consensus dividend (https://www.finanzen.net/schaetzungen/verbio) is a blend of zero and something, and nothing public has said which way the board will go. At EUR 0.20 the yield is about 0.65%, so even a full reinstatement is worth little. It is sized as a signal of board confidence, not as cash.
findings.independence: The net-debt figure of about EUR 92m comes from a different document, the 3 Aug 2026 ad-hoc (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/verbio-se-preliminary-ebitda-for-fy-2025-2026-exceeds-forecast/31cf057f-fad8-477c-a599-87d107b49e0b_en). The CEO quote and finding 1 share one document, but they rest on different statements in it: dividend policy here, guiding method there.

outside_window.finding: Capital Markets Day for analysts and institutional investors in Bitterfeld on 8 Oct 2026. NuWays expects medium-term earnings targets, capital allocation and the renewable-chemicals rollout there, so management may hold medium-term colour back from the 24 Sep call.

About 0.66m t of 2024 GHG quotas are carried in inventory and can only be used from quota year 2027. NuWays puts them at about EUR 227m net cash at EUR 400/t, monetised across FY27/28 and FY28/29. The same carry-over resumes for the whole industry in 2027, which could weigh on the 2027 quota price. It is real, but it is monetised after this window and may or may not appear in the FY27 guide.

My small negative on the guide goes against that, but the market has already de-rated the stock about 30% from its April high, which is why the number sits near zero.
language_note: The German originals were needed to quote the guiding method in the filed language ('Er legt dabei historische Markt-Spreads zugrunde') and the CEO's 'mittelfristig' qualifier on the dividend. The English EQS versions carry the same content, so this is quotation, not new information.

German aggregators (finanzen.net Schätzungen) were the only reachable source for a FY26/27 consensus (EUR 265.81m EBITDA, 4 analysts, dividend EUR 0.07). No English source reached from here carried a forward consensus.

lessons_applied: 'The hunter's own caveat has to reach the number': finding 1's own evidence says the conservative-guide pattern was visible three times in FY26 and that the stock already trades far below consensus-implied value. Cut it from -1.0 to -0.8, and cut expected_move from -0.5 to -0.4, below the findings sum.
'Verify the bar' and the cap for an unsourced bar: the FY27 consensus is one aggregator and visibly partly stale, so both findings are held small and the band on finding 1 stays wide.
'A German ad-hoc filed before the print may have pre-released the number': confirmed it had (3 Aug ad-hoc, EUR 192m). The reported year is treated as known (0% vs bar), which the draft already did.
'Keep findings inside the exit window': moved the 8 Oct Capital Markets Day and the 2027 quota monetisation into outside_window at zero. The draft had already kept them out of findings.
'Truncated zero is not a measurement': positioning_check rewritten to say the register gives no anchor rather than 'nobody short'.
